description: We are a passionate team interested in Data Science, Earth Science, AI/ML, and Web Development. Our mission is to explore NASA's Earth observation data, identify environmental trends, and transform complex datasets into meaningful insights through interactive visualizations. We welcome enthusiastic teammates skilled in Python, Data Analysis, Machine Learning, GIS, Data Visualization, Web Development, and scientific research who are eager to collaborate and make an impact.
summary: Earth Trend Detective is an interactive web application designed to help people explore and understand environmental changes on our planet using NASA Earth observation data. It addresses the challenge by making complex scientific datasets easier to investigate, compare, and interpret. Users can explore environmental topics such as land surface temperature, wildfire activity, vegetation changes, and rainfall patterns by selecting a location and time period. The platform aims to process and analyze relevant data and present meaningful patterns through interactive maps, charts, visual comparisons, and easy-to-understand explanations. By transforming satellite and environmental observations into accessible visual insights, Earth Trend Detective aims to make Earth science more engaging and understandable for students, researchers, educators, and the public. It encourages evidence-based environmental awareness and helps people better understand how Earth's systems change over time.
details:
Earth Trend Detective is an interactive environmental data exploration platform designed to help people understand how Earth's systems change over time using NASA Earth observation data.

The platform aims to make complex scientific datasets easier to explore and interpret. Users can select an environmental topic such as land surface temperature, wildfire activity, vegetation changes, or rainfall, choose a geographical region and time period, and investigate relevant observations.

The proposed workflow includes collecting NASA data, cleaning and processing datasets, performing exploratory data analysis, comparing observations across different periods, and identifying environmental patterns. Results can be presented through interactive maps, charts, visual comparisons, and simple explanations supported by data.

The project aims to benefit students, researchers, educators, environmental organizations, and the general public by making Earth science more accessible and encouraging evidence-based environmental awareness.

Its creative approach is to make users environmental data detectives: instead of simply viewing satellite images, they can investigate questions, compare observations, and understand findings with their supporting evidence.

The proposed technology stack includes Python, Pandas, NumPy, Plotly, Streamlit, Folium, and NASA data resources. The team also considers data accuracy, geographical coverage, time periods, measurement units, missing observations, dataset compatibility, and scientific limitations to help ensure responsible interpretation of results.
